parameters.launcherWarmup: default enabled; sessions body first, then background version/workspaces/models/pi-settings

definitions.listenerMs: Time from spawning the real launcher to the first complete HTTP /api/health 200 or 401; this is not TCP listen time
definitions.authenticatedHealthMs: Time from spawn to completed private IPC login plus authenticated health body and JSON validation
definitions.firstSessionsMsSinceSpawn: Time from spawn to a completed authenticated sessions body, JSON parse and validation of all 300 sessions
definitions.firstSessionsRequestMs: Legacy comparable per-request measure ends at body completion before JSON parsing, exactly as the baseline helper
definitions.firstSessionsValidatedRequestMs: Additional request-only measure including JSON parsing and 300-session validation
definitions.firstPageRequestMs: Authenticated HTML request ends after UTF-8 decoding and HTML validation; follows sessions and is not an independent cold page load
definitions.launcherReadyMs: Receipt of the launcher ready log after its sessions warmup; background warmup may continue

limitations: OS file cache is not cleared between runs.
The fixture has fresh agent storage each run but the same synthetic session and workspace sizes as the baseline.
Default launcher warmup may overlap the measured first sessions request.
The baseline has three runs and the optimized run has five; this is a local observation, not a statistical guarantee.
Source changes include startup, server caching, and frontend optimizations; end-to-end change cannot be attributed solely to validation deduplication.

runs.error: Resource sampler lost the service process tree; empty samples are not a valid idle result
